items.author: Wealthmanager
items.context: Wealthmanager (con gráfico): $BTC cotiza cerca del cuantil inferior del 1% de su modelo Power Law; históricamente esa zona marcó infravaloración profunda.
items.suggested_text: Bottom 1% says where price sits vs. its own history, not how long it stays there. That's why sizing matters more than the signal: spot, no leverage, an amount you can hold if $BTC lingers. How the model works: https://x.com/forecastquant/status/2118779927340470279

items.author: Washigorira
items.context: Titan: el RSI diario se reseteó; la última vez BTC marcó un piso local. Se forma una divergencia alcista oculta sobre la zona de soporte $58K-$64K; aún necesita un mínimo diario confirmado y perder el mínimo de julio la invalidaría.
items.suggested_text: Appreciate that it comes with an invalidation level, most calls don't. Until that daily low is confirmed, spot and no leverage is what keeps a wick below $58K from being the whole story. $BTC

items.author: ourcryptotalk
items.context: Our Crypto Talk: estamos en Miedo Extremo; repasa cada mínimo anual del Fear & Greed desde 2018. En 2018 y 2022 lo peor aún venía; en 2020, 2021 y 2024 siguieron recuperaciones fuertes. Concluye que el miedo no marca necesariamente el piso.
items.suggested_text: The 2018 and 2022 rows are the useful ones: extreme fear can last months before the low. That's why size beats timing here: spot, no leverage, an amount of $BTC you won't be forced to sell.

items.author: SimplyBitcoin
items.context: Simply Bitcoin (resumen de noticias): Saylor suma 1.036 BTC mientras MSCI saca a Strategy el 30-nov; ballenas de IBIT pasan a autocustodia en cifras récord 'por seguridad'; Wood sobre oro vs Bitcoin; Trump en 60 Minutes sobre World Liberty.
items.suggested_text: "For safety" is the interesting part. Leaving the fund removes the custodian, but then the risk moves to your setup: where keys are generated, which device, which vendor you still depend on. I wrote a short book on building your own air-gapped setup: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HQ5NS31N?dplnkId=c09ef739-11f3-4c76-8c62-92ce160a3341&nodl=1
